text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"}],"comment":"The title block heat treatment field is '---', yet note N3 (page 1, '1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC. 2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm. 3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.') specifies case hardening without stating at which manufacturing stage it applies. The designer should fill the heat treatment field and add the process stage (e.g., after rough machining, before final thread cutting) so the shop knows when to perform it.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat treatment field with the specified case hardening details and state the manufacturing stage in note N3."},{"rule_id":"WPS-004","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D1","page":1,"quote":"-0.017"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N5","page":1,"quote":"# FINISH: I.Z.B.P. (TRIVALENT)"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N3","page":1,"quote":"4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"Dimension D1 shows a tolerance band of only 0.017 mm on the M16 thread feature F1, and the part is zinc plated per note N5; although note N3 conditionally calls for retapping after surface treatment, the '( IF APPLICABLE )' qualifier leaves it ambiguous whether plating build-up is accounted for on this tight thread tolerance. The designer must make the post-plating retap instruction unconditional or explicitly provide for plating thickness in the thread dimensions.","recommended_correction":"Remove the '( IF APPLICABLE )' condition from note N3 item 4 so retapping after plating is mandatory, or adjust the pre-plate thread size to allow for coating thickness."}]}
